objective: Deliver the best justified, stable, independently verified CouncilFlow release candidate by auditing the ENTIRE current project and repairing ALL confirmed, in-scope, technically repairable defects, not just E10. Eliminate repeated speculative loops. Preserve Owner authority and frozen governance.

acceptance.criterion: Full scoped audit performed with evidence, and no confirmed in-scope repairable defect knowingly left without disposition.
Source fixes independently tested with meaningful negative controls; E10 integrity intact.
Independent Tester and Reviewer command comparison accepted, with final Planner original-criteria map.
All applicable final checkout/extraction suites have accurate outcomes; no hidden mandatory failures.
Frozen governance unchanged; no unauthorized actions, false identity/OS sandbox claims or historical evidence rewriting.
Release package/checksum verified, installation instructions coherent, and local Git checkpoint finalized if changes were made.
Gate 3 separately and truthfully classified as verified/failed/blocked/unverified per its frozen evidence rules, rather than treated as a release-test checkbox.

criteria_provenance.source: Original Owner mission in inherited native session; exact seven COMPLETE bullets copied without changing text

scope: Other active in-repository docs/examples only when a confirmed minimal in-scope correction is necessary
protected: All pre-existing historical records and Owner working changes/untracked artifacts
Global Codex/OS configuration and other projects
authority: This mission authorization, subject to frozen governance; then Charter/frozen Gate3/C3; current normative skill/policy/contracts; source/current evidence; historical context last.

tasks.work: Inspect all current source/config/docs/tests/releases and relevant historical chains; independently reproduce findings; create classification ledger.
tasks.output: Audit ledger and immutable minimal reproductions; no speculative repairs.

tasks.work: Repair every confirmed in-scope fixable finding with minimal code/tests/docs changes and developer checks; cumulative candidate inventory binds all active source bytes.
tasks.output: Worker report, changed files, stopped edits, cumulative immutable candidate.

tasks.work: Independently verify exact stabilized candidate with current suites and meaningful controls, followed by unchanged deterministic command rerun and original-plan comparison.
dependency: Manager-approved oracle and post-Worker MCP synchronization/fallback
tasks.output: Actual command/raw output/exits/input and candidate hashes; separate role reports.

tasks.owner: Fresh bounded packaging Worker or authorized release-file Worker before final verification
tasks.work: Build one final allowlisted release ZIP with source/tests/docs, excluding current transient evidence/history duplicates; independently test final checkout and fresh final extraction.
tasks.output: Final ZIP/checksum/entry manifest/CRC/byte comparison and extraction results.

tasks.owner: Manager then original Planner then Manager
tasks.work: Reconcile immutable evidence, original map and findings; record final check; stage/review only intended files, commit locally and verify postcommit state.
tasks.output: Final Planner results, local commit and concise Owner handoff.

rework_policy: A genuine mandatory failure requires preserved evidence and causal rework with fresh Worker/attempt and independent recheck. Newly discovered authorized release/docs follow-up may begin its own truthful task boundary; do not invent failed Tester/Planner decisions to force sequence grammar. No arbitrary lifetime repair cap; stop identical evidence-free retries.

verification_strategy.approval: Proposal for parent Manager to approve in assignment; Tester cannot self-approve or substitute oracle.
verification_strategy.suite_inventory: Inspect every current test/demo/operational command; add any further applicable current suite discovered. Intentional demo/starter and archived historical snapshots must be separately labeled, never mixed into current pass totals.
controls: Exact E10 ordered string/ID mutations and absent/stale required artifact; ordinary no-sidecar plan remains valid.
Controlled JSON/schema/context/origin/candidate/oracle/replay/rework/mandatory-failure mutations tied to production helper.
Disposable path/symlink/junction inside/outside/stale checks; Windows and genuinely available WSL/Linux separately.
Targeted production mutation testing in disposable copies for confirmed high-impact findings.
MCP live bounded same-root status/coverage and post-edit refresh; static missing/offline/etc lifecycle checks labeled static when live injection unavailable.
JSON operational examples, policy/TOML parsers, package secret/cache/runtime/name scan, CRC and every extracted byte.
verification_strategy.execution_evidence: Resolve exact Python executable path; record arguments, cwd, candidate and input identities, actual exit, raw stdout/stderr; normalized stdout SHA256 uses only CRLF-to-LF replacement. Select a deterministic command with meaningful stdout such as stable sorted test-result JSON, excluding timing, before Reviewer sees results; do not alter oracle after results.
verification_strategy.final_archive: Run all applicable suites again from isolated extraction of FINAL archive; verify hash/name/size/CRC/bytes for every entry and no self-inclusion.
verification_strategy.independence: Fresh native Worker/Tester/Reviewer are distinct; Reviewer independently invokes exact Tester declaration, not shell alias; Planner final check uses immutable original C01-C07 plus full derived map.
verification_strategy.limits: Host activation/TOML provenance and OS isolation are separate from structural/runtime tests; synthetic fixtures cannot prove real Owner approval; WinError1314 skips do not pass security checks.

gate3_disposition: No new separately approved experiment. Current E1/E2/E4 capability inspection already completed once by Manager: UNVERIFIED (HOST_CAPABILITY_MISSING). Preserve historical E10 FAIL and historical supported E3/E5/E6/E7/E8/E9 only with surviving sources; this release cannot retroactively change them.

risks.risk: Current workflow/communication require criteria sidecar universally while Owner explicitly allows ordinary coding requests without one.
risks.handling: Treat as a candidate documentation/behavior finding; independently reproduce, minimally clarify distinction; do not manufacture Owner approval.

risks.risk: Candidate/package/report self-reference leads to A004-A009-style churn.
risks.handling: Freeze cumulative product bytes and archive before final verification, store current evidence outside ZIP, separate genuine follow-up tasks from failed criteria.

risks.risk: Installed copies differ from repository, no global install authorized.
risks.handling: Document drift and use explicit project copy; no global edits.

risks.risk: Hidden source bugs or unsupported platforms cannot be universally excluded.
risks.handling: Bound audit evidence, disclose uncertain host/platform issues and never claim all bugs eliminated.
